raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Some deployments need a main model from ModelScope and an EAGLE draft from Hugging Face. The global `SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE` switch cannot express this combination.

For example, [GLM-4.7-Flash is available on ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/ZhipuAI/GLM-4.7-Flash), while [thoughtworks/GLM-4.7-Flash-Eagle3 is on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/thoughtworks/GLM-4.7-Flash-Eagle3). I could not find a same-ID ModelScope mirror of this draft.

```bash
sglang serve \
  --model-path modelscope://ZhipuAI/GLM-4.7-Flash \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 \
  --speculative-draft-model-path hf://thoughtworks/GLM-4.7-Flash-Eagle3
```

## Modifications

- Accept `hf://owner/repo` and `modelscope://owner/repo` for the model, tokenizer, and speculative draft model.
- Resolve explicit sources through the selected Hub SDK into local snapshots, then reuse the existing loaders. Authentication, caching, download directories, and revision arguments remain SDK-managed.
- Keep bare `owner/repo` IDs, local paths, remote-storage protocols, and automatic built-in draft selection unchanged. No environment switching or cross-Hub fallback.
- Support the LLM CLI and Python `Engine`; SGLang Diffusion is outside this scope.

To keep this change small, models download complete repository snapshots, potentially including alternate weight formats. Tokenizer-only and dummy loads fetch metadata only. Cross-repository `auto_map` references and unsupported loaders fail explicitly; pre-downloaded local paths remain available for those cases.

## Testing

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest --noconftest \
  test/registered/unit/test_model_hub.py \
  test/registered/unit/cli/test_utils.py \
  test/registered/unit/server_args/test_model_source_paths.py -q
# 59 passed, 6 subtests passed
```

Tests mock both Hub SDKs and cover mixed sources, legacy paths, revisions, tokenizer defaults, shared snapshots, failures, and implicit DSpark draft resolution. Changed-file pre-commit checks and `git diff --check` passed.

No GPU service or real model download was run. Mintlify validation was unavailable locally because its CLI is not installed. AI assistance was used.

+## Select a source for each model
+
+You can use `hf://owner/repo` or `modelscope://owner/repo` with
+`--model-path`, `--tokenizer-path`, and `--speculative-draft-model-path`.
+Each prefix selects that repository's source independently of
+`SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE`, so the target and draft can come from different Hubs:
+
+```bash
+sglang serve \
+    --model-path modelscope://ZhipuAI/GLM-4.7-Flash \
+    --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 \
+    --speculative-draft-model-path hf://thoughtworks/GLM-4.7-Flash-Eagle3
+```
+
+Use the repository ID published by the selected Hub; the same weights can have
+different IDs on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
+
+The prefixes work with the LLM server (`sglang serve` or
+`python -m sglang.launch_server`) and Python `Engine`, not SGLang Diffusion.
+Omitted tokenizers use the target checkpoint; the default served model name is
+the target's `owner/repo`.
+
+Only repository roots are supported. Select versions with `--revision` or
+`--speculative-draft-model-revision`, not within the prefixed path. Each SDK
+handles authentication and caching (`--download-dir`); failed downloads do not
+switch Hubs. ModelScope sources require the `modelscope` package.
+
+Models download a complete repository snapshot, then use the existing loader;
+repositories containing multiple weight formats may download extra files.
+Tokenizer-only and `dummy` loads fetch metadata only. Supported weight loaders
+are `auto`, `safetensors`, `fastsafetensors`, `instanttensor`, `pt`, `npcache`, and
+`mistral`; use a local snapshot for other loaders.
+
+Custom code within the same repository still uses `--trust-remote-code`.
+Cross-repository `auto_map` references are not supported with explicit prefixes;
+prepare the model and its code locally instead.
+
+Unprefixed IDs, local paths, and existing remote-storage URLs are unchanged.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Lightweight Hub reference parsing and startup path resolution."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from huggingface_hub.utils import HFValidationError, validate_repo_id
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_METADATA_PATTERNS = [
+    "*.json",
+    "*.py",
+    "*.model*",
+    "*.txt",
+    "*.tiktoken",
+    "*.jinja",
+    "*.bpe",
+    "*.vocab",
+    "*.spm",
+]
+
+
+def parse_model_hub_reference(path: str | None) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+    """Parse hf://owner/repo or modelscope://owner/repo, leaving other paths alone."""
+    if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
+        return None
+    source, separator, repo_id = path.partition("://")
+    if not separator or source not in ("hf", "modelscope"):
+        return None
+    try:
+        if repo_id.count("/") != 1:
+            raise HFValidationError("Expected owner/repo")
+        validate_repo_id(repo_id)
+    except HFValidationError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Expected {source}://owner/repo without a file path, query, or "
+            "embedded revision; use the existing revision arguments."
+        ) from exc
+    return source, repo_id
+
+
+def _download_model(reference, revision, cfg, metadata_only):
+    from huggingface_hub.constants import HF_HUB_OFFLINE
+
+    source, repo_id = reference
+    if source == "hf":
+        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+    else:
+        from modelscope.hub.snapshot_download import snapshot_download
+
+    def check_config(config):
+        if "--" in json.dumps(config.get("auto_map", {})):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Explicit Hub sources do not support cross-repository auto_map; "
+                "download the model and code locally first."
+            )
+        return config
+
+    try:
+        snapshot = Path(
+            snapshot_download(
+                repo_id,
+                revision=revision,
+                cache_dir=cfg.download_dir,
+                local_files_only=HF_HUB_OFFLINE,
+                allow_patterns=_METADATA_PATTERNS if metadata_only else None,
+            )
+        )
+        for path in snapshot.rglob("*config*.json"):
+            try:
+                json.loads(path.read_text(), object_hook=check_config)
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                # Required configs are validated by the regular loader.
+                continue
+        return str(snapshot)
+    except Exception:
+        logger.error("Failed to resolve %s://%s", source, repo_id)
+        raise
+
+
+def resolve_model_hub_paths(cfg: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Validate explicit sources, then resolve models before tokenizer-only paths."""
+    references = {
+        field: parse_model_hub_reference(getattr(cfg, field))
+        for field in ("model_path", "speculative_draft_model_path", "tokenizer_path")
+    }
+    model_reference = references["model_path"]
+    if model_reference is not None and cfg.tokenizer_path is None:
+        references["tokenizer_path"] = model_reference
+    formats = {}
+    for field, reference in references.items():
+        if reference is None:
+            continue
+        load_format = (
+            cfg.speculative_draft_load_format
+            if field == "speculative_draft_model_path"
+            else None
+        ) or cfg.load_format
+        formats[field] = "dummy" if field == "tokenizer_path" else load_format.lower()
+        if formats[field] not in (
+            "auto",
+            "safetensors",
+            "fastsafetensors",
+            "instanttensor",
+            "mistral",
+            "pt",
+            "npcache",
+            "dummy",
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Explicit Hub sources do not support load_format={load_format!r}; "
+                "download a local snapshot for this loader."
+            )
+    resolved = {}
+    if model_reference is not None and cfg.served_model_name is None:
+        resolved["served_model_name"] = model_reference[1]
+    snapshots = {}
+    for field, reference in references.items():
+        if reference is None:
+            continue
+        draft = field == "speculative_draft_model_path"
+        revision = cfg.speculative_draft_model_revision if draft else cfg.revision
+        key = (reference, revision, formats[field] == "dummy")
+        if field == "tokenizer_path":
+            key = next((k for k in snapshots if k[:2] == key[:2]), key)
+        if key not in snapshots:
+            snapshots[key] = _download_model(reference, revision, cfg, key[2])
+        resolved[field] = snapshots[key]
+    return resolved

+
+import argparse
+import fnmatch
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import ANY, Mock, patch
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_path_hook import handle_model_source_paths
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolving_view
+from sglang.srt.model_hub import parse_model_hub_reference, resolve_model_hub_paths
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def hubs(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    for source in ("hf", "ms"):
+        folder = tmp_path / source
+        folder.mkdir()
+        (folder / "model.safetensors").touch()
+    hf, ms = (Mock(return_value=str(tmp_path / source)) for source in ("hf", "ms"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr("huggingface_hub.snapshot_download", hf)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("huggingface_hub.constants.HF_HUB_OFFLINE", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("huggingface_hub.constants.HF_HUB_CACHE", str(tmp_path / "hub"))
+    monkeypatch.setitem(
+        sys.modules,
+        "modelscope.hub.snapshot_download",
+        SimpleNamespace(snapshot_download=ms),
+    )
+    return {"hf": hf, "modelscope": ms}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["hf", "modelscope"])
+def test_validation_and_legacy_paths(hubs, source):
+    assert parse_model_hub_reference(f"{source}://Org/Model-1.5") == (
+        source,
+        "Org/Model-1.5",
+    )
+    for repo in (
+        "",
+        "owner",
+        "owner/repo/file",
+        "owner/repo@v1",
+        "owner/repo?x=1",
+        "owner/repo#v1",
+        "../repo",
+        "owner/repo.git",
+        "owner/.repo",
+        "owner/repo-",
+    ):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Expected"):
+            resolve_model_hub_paths(
+                ServerArgs(
+                    model_path="hf://Org/valid", tokenizer_path=f"{source}://{repo}"
+                )
+            )
+    for path in (
+        "owner/repo",
+        "/models/repo",
+        "./model",
+        "s3://bucket/model",
+        "gs://bucket/model",
+        "az://bucket/model",
+        "redis://host/model",
+        "instance://host/model",
+        "https://huggingface.co/Org/Model",
+        "owner/repo:Q4_K_M",
+    ):
+        assert resolve_model_hub_paths(ServerArgs(model_path=path)) == {}
+    for download in hubs.values():
+        download.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("global_source", ["true", "false"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["hf", "modelscope"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "field", ["model_path", "tokenizer_path", "speculative_draft_model_path"]
+)
+def test_fields_override_global_source(hubs, monkeypatch, global_source, source, field):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE", global_source)

+    assert resolved[field] == hubs[source].return_value
+    if field == "model_path":
+        assert resolved["tokenizer_path"] == resolved["model_path"]

+    hubs[source].assert_called_once_with(
+        "Org/repo",
+        revision=None,
+        cache_dir=None,
+        local_files_only=True,
+        allow_patterns=ANY,
+    )
+    assert (hubs[source].call_args.kwargs["allow_patterns"] is None) == (

+    )
+    hubs["hf" if source == "modelscope" else "modelscope"].assert_not_called()
+    assert getattr(args, field) == f"{source}://Org/repo"
+    assert os.environ["SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE"] == global_source

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+        == hubs[draft_source].return_value
+    )
+    assert view.served_model_name == "Org/target"
+    hubs[source].assert_called_once_with(
+        "Org/target",
+        revision="v1",
+        cache_dir="/custom",
+        local_files_only=True,
+        allow_patterns=None,
+    )
+    assert [call.kwargs["revision"] for call in hubs[draft_source].call_args_list] == [
+        "v2",
+        "v1",
+    ]
+    assert args.model_path == options["model_path"]
+
+
+def test_resolution_pipeline_preserves_implicit_dspark_draft(hubs, monkeypatch):
+    from transformers import LlamaConfig
+
+    snapshot = hubs["hf"].return_value
+    LlamaConfig(
+        architectures=["LlamaForCausalLM"],
+        hidden_size=16,
+        intermediate_size=32,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+        num_key_value_heads=2,
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        vocab_size=128,
+        max_position_embeddings=2048,
+        dspark_block_size=2,
+        dspark_markov_rank=1,
+        dspark_noise_token_id=1,
+        dspark_target_layer_ids=[0],
+    ).save_pretrained(snapshot)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE", "true")
+    args = ServerArgs(
+        model_path="hf://Org/repo",
+        device="cuda",
+        speculative_algorithm="DSPARK",
+        revision="v1",
+    )
+    args.resolve_once()
+    cfg = resolving_view(args)
+    assert (
+        cfg.model_path
+        == cfg.tokenizer_path
+        == cfg.speculative_draft_model_path
+        == snapshot
+    )
+    assert cfg.speculative_draft_model_revision == "v1"
+    assert cfg.served_model_name == "Org/repo"
+    hubs["hf"].assert_called_once()
+    hubs["modelscope"].assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "revision,draft_format,load_format,calls",
+    [
+        ("v1", None, "auto", 1),
+        ("v1", "pt", "auto", 1),
+        ("v2", None, "auto", 2),
+        ("v1", "dummy", "auto", 2),
+        ("v1", None, "DUMMY", 1),
+    ],
+)
+def test_shared_snapshots(hubs, revision, draft_format, load_format, calls):
+    result = resolve_model_hub_paths(
+        ServerArgs(
+            model_path="hf://Org/repo",
+            tokenizer_path="hf://Org/repo",
+            speculative_draft_model_path="hf://Org/repo",
+            served_model_name="custom",
+            revision="v1",
+            speculative_draft_model_revision=revision,
+            speculative_draft_load_format=draft_format,
+            load_format=load_format,
+        )
+    )
+    assert result["tokenizer_path"] == result["model_path"]
+    assert hubs["hf"].call_count == calls
+    assert "served_model_name" not in result
+    if load_format == "DUMMY":
+        patterns = hubs["hf"].call_args.kwargs["allow_patterns"]
+        assert "*.json" in patterns and "*.safetensors" not in patterns
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["hf", "modelscope"])
+def test_failure_preserves_exception_without_fallback(hubs, caplog, source):
+    error = OSError("Hub unavailable")
+    hubs[source].side_effect = error
+    with pytest.raises(OSError) as caught:
+        resolve_model_hub_paths(ServerArgs(model_path=f"{source}://Org/repo"))
+    assert caught.value is error
+    assert f"{source}://Org/repo" in caplog.text
+    hubs["hf" if source == "modelscope" else "modelscope"].assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["hf", "modelscope"])
+def test_full_snapshot_preserves_bundled_weights_in_one_fetch(hubs, source, tmp_path):
+    folder = tmp_path / "snapshot"
+    folder.mkdir()
+    files = [
+        "config.json",
+        "pytorch_model.bin",
+        "draft/model.safetensors",
+        "original/model.safetensors",
+    ]
+
+    def download(repo, *, allow_patterns, **kwargs):
+        for name in files:
+            if allow_patterns is None or any(
+                fnmatch.fnmatch(name, p) for p in allow_patterns
+            ):
+                path = folder / name
+                path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
+                path.write_text("{}")
+        return str(folder)
+
+    hubs[source].side_effect = download
+    result = resolve_model_hub_paths(
+        ServerArgs(model_path=f"{source}://Org/repo", revision="main")
+    )
+    assert result["model_path"] == str(folder)
+    assert all((folder / name).is_file() for name in files)
+    # A single SDK resolution cannot mix metadata from one branch tip with
+    # weights downloaded after the branch has advanced to another commit.
+    assert hubs[source].call_count == 1
+    assert hubs[source].call_args.kwargs["allow_patterns"] is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("trust", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "filename,config",
+    [
+        ("config.json", {"auto_map": {"AutoConfig": "Org/code--config.Custom"}}),
+        (
+            "tokenizer_config.json",
+            {"auto_map": {"AutoTokenizer": ["Org/code--tok.Custom", None]}},
+        ),
+        ("tokenizer_config.json", {"auto_map": ["Org/code--tok.Custom", None]}),
+        (
+            "config.json",
+            {"text_config": {"auto_map": {"AutoConfig": "Org/code--config.Custom"}}},
+        ),
+        ("dspark/config.json", {"auto_map": {"AutoConfig": "Org/code--config.Custom"}}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_cross_repo_auto_map_rejected_without_code_fetch(hubs, trust, filename, config):
+    path = Path(hubs["modelscope"].return_value) / filename
+    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    original = json.dumps(config)
+    path.write_text(original)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="auto_map"):
+        resolve_model_hub_paths(
+            ServerArgs(model_path="modelscope://Org/repo", trust_remote_code=trust)
+        )
+    assert hubs["modelscope"].call_count == 1
+    hubs["hf"].assert_not_called()
+    assert path.read_text() == original
+
+
+def test_local_auto_map_and_unrelated_json_are_left_unchanged(hubs):
+    snapshot = Path(hubs["hf"].return_value)
+    configs = {
+        "config.json": json.dumps({"auto_map": {"AutoConfig": "configuration.Local"}}),
+        "tokenizer_config.json": json.dumps({"auto_map": ["tokenization.Local", None]}),
+        "other_config.json": "not valid JSON",
+        "list_config.json": "[null, 1]",
+        "scalar_config.json": "null",
+    }
+    for name, content in configs.items():
+        (snapshot / name).write_text(content)
+    result = resolve_model_hub_paths(
+        ServerArgs(model_path="hf://Org/repo", trust_remote_code=True)
+    )
+    assert result["model_path"] == str(snapshot)
+    assert all(
+        (snapshot / name).read_text() == content for name, content in configs.items()
+    )
+
+
+def test_unsupported_loader_fails_before_download(hubs):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="local snapshot"):
+        resolve_model_hub_paths(
+            ServerArgs(model_path="hf://Org/repo", load_format="gguf")
+        )
+    hubs["hf"].assert_not_called()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))
